review.evidence: Ethereum block 26110197 native TrustService RoleAdded/RoleRemoved replay and getRole/code checks resolve one MASTER, six ISSUERs and one TRANSFER_AGENT. Four issuer contracts are ERC-1967 proxies, two with unverified implementations; full authorization/bypass closure is not established. MASTER can mint and immediately upgrade token and trust service. Solana account reads bind the authority to upgradeable program 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP and ProgramData upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6, not a signing policy. W4 R12 independently re-verified the complete W3R25 Tempo role census on 2026-10-05 at block 42641165, closing only that aggregate question. Tempo token/trust implementations additionally match the verified Ethereum references outside compiler-declared self-address immutable and TokenLibrary link ranges, including metadata; the linked Tempo TokenLibrary matches its verified Ethereum reference outside compiler-declared library callProtection bytes. This is bounded executable correspondence, not full issuer/proxy/upstream authorization or signing closure. The SEC 485BPOS filed 31 July 2026, accession 0001193125-26-327203, and its EDGAR register were independently verified on 2026-10-04: BlackRock Funds is an Investment Company Act of 1940 registered open-end management investment company (40 Act file 811-05742), and its issuing series BlackRock Daily Reinvestment Stablecoin Reserve Vehicle is a government money market fund under Rule 2a-7. The prospectus's Use of the Blockchain section expressly subjects this exact OnChain Shares class (CUSIP 09261A839, ticker RSVXX), including its native multi-network ownership records, to the same fund investment requirements. Ongoing SEC Rule 2a-7 quality, diversification, liquidity and maturity requirements over this issuing fund support prudential supervision; this is not a claim based on transfer-agent licensing, custodian regulation, BUIDL coverage, SEC endorsement or a reserve guarantee. Deloitte & Touche LLP is named independent accountant, but appointment does not establish a dated completed attestation or audit history. The SAI also says the transfer agent typically reconciles records with blockchain transactions at least daily, and BNY reconciles securities/cash with the custodian. These separate register and portfolio processes do not establish all on/off-chain token liabilities reconciled to backing on one common clock; reconciliation remains unknown. Chronicle BUIDL coverage cannot be inherited by this separate fund. The unverified Ethereum implementations, complete Tempo authority reach and Solana deployed-runtime correspondence remain independently unresolved.
